items.q: What is the first move supposed to prove?
items.a: Not that every detail is perfect. That you had the **courage to start**. You are allowed to start before it is figured out.

items.q: What does he call chasing perfection?
items.a: **Procrastination with better branding.** The wait looks like standards. He says it is delay.

items.q: What should the start feel like?
items.a: **Awkward, cringe, messy.** That is not a sign you began too early. That is exactly how it should feel.

items.q: What if it does not work out?
items.a: **What if it does?** If it doesn't, now you know. That is how you build experience and the next version of yourself.

items.q: Why can't you improve it yet?
items.a: **You can't improve something that doesn't exist.** The line he repeats three times: make it exist first, then make it great.
